cluster.headline: ישראל בדרך לריסוק כלכלי | נדב איל
cluster.body_note: Copyrighted content, full body not reproduced by WebFetch; summarized via prompt extraction. Opinion column (Nadav Eyal) that is mostly analysis/opinion but cites two concrete figures: (1) Israel Innovation Authority (רשות החדשנות) figure of ~$85B in hi-tech exports of goods+services in 2025, ~58% of total Israeli exports; (2) reference to a Bank of Israel forecast published that week warning of escalating-sanctions risk (no figures given for #2). Most of the rest of the column (US aid figure $38B/through 2028, characterizations of Iran/Russia sanctions evasion, crypto/banking commentary) is framing/analysis without a citable primary source, per scope rule.
